quarterly_data.quarter: Stella Chemifa results presentation: Business Results for 1Q of FYE 3/2027 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 1Q of FYE 3/2027 (April-June 2026): sales revenue JPY 9,754 million (+10.9%) and operating profit JPY 1,242 million (+1.6%). Sales rose on price pass-through in Semiconductors and higher Electronic Materials shipments; the High-Purity Chemical Business (sales JPY 8,383 million, +10.2%) saw operating profit fall to JPY 902 million from JPY 998 million due to a sharp rise in the price of anhydrous hydrofluoric acid, its key raw material. Semiconductors sales were JPY 5,884 million (+10.2%), 70% of high-purity chemicals sales; overseas share of high-purity chemicals sales 56.1%.
quarterly_data.figure: 1Q sales JPY 9,754 million (+10.9%); operating profit JPY 1,242 million; Semiconductors sales JPY 5,884 million (+10.2%)
